criteria.text: Running `python todo.py` with no flag still prints the numbered list, and `--json` output is not numbered text
criteria.verify: python todo.py | grep -qx '1. buy milk' && ! python todo.py --json | grep -q '^1\. '  && python todo.py --json | grep -q '^\['

criteria.text: A test in test_todo.py covers the --json output and passes

Run the test and the shell checks to confirm they pass
